summary: ImmuCell filed an 8-K reporting a Settlement Deed with Norbrook Laboratories resolving claims from a 2019 Development Services and Commercial Supply Agreement that expired March 31, 2026. Norbrook will pay ImmuCell $2 million; the settlement includes no admission of liability. This is a litigation resolution, not a special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The agreement is governed by Northern Ireland law. No other terms like price per share or premium are applicable. There is no risk-arb angle; the filing is a routine material definitive agreement and should be classified as None.
